title: Linear Regression from Scratch with Gradient Descent in R
description: Implements ordinary least squares and gradient descent by hand on a small housing table, plots the loss surface and compares the hand-written fit with the built-in function to see where numbers agree and why.

title: K-Nearest Neighbours Classifier with Scaling Experiments
description: Builds a nearest-neighbour classifier and shows how unscaled features, the choice of k and the distance metric change accuracy on a small mixed-feature dataset, with a chart for each experiment.

title: Naive Bayes Fraud Screener for a Small Online Shop
description: Trains a naive Bayes model on a few thousand orders to flag suspicious ones for manual review, and explains the cost of false alarms versus misses so the shop owner can pick a sensible threshold.

title: Customer Segmentation with RFM and Clustering in R
description: Computes recency, frequency and monetary scores from a transactions table and groups customers with k-means, then describes each segment in plain language and suggests one action per segment.

title: Gradient Boosting from Scratch for Regression
description: Implements a small gradient boosting regressor with shallow trees, then compares it with a library version on accuracy, training time and sensitivity to learning rate and tree depth.

title: Time-Aware Cross-Validation Library for Tabular Models
description: Provides splitters that respect time order and group membership so a model is never scored on data from before its training period, and demonstrates the optimistic error that ordinary shuffled folds produce.

title: Anomaly Detection on Server Logs with Isolation Forest and Rules
description: Turns request logs into per-minute features and combines an isolation forest with simple threshold rules, then compares which anomalies each approach catches and which it misses.

title: Survey-Based Voting Intention Model with Poststratification
description: Fits a multilevel model to a skewed opinion survey and reweights it to known population shares, reporting uncertainty by region and showing how raw averages mislead. Includes a written note on what the model cannot say.

title: Calibrated Probability Forecasts for Match Outcomes with Elo
description: Builds an Elo-style rating system for a sport, converts rating gaps into win probabilities and checks calibration against results season by season. Includes reliability plots and a comparison with a naive home-advantage baseline.

title: Energy-Efficient Model Selection Under a Compute Budget
description: Compares models of increasing size on accuracy per unit of measured training energy, and builds a recommendation rule that picks the smallest model within a chosen accuracy tolerance.
